content: Eliphaz ni Job yon a pen
Hahoi Teman tami Eliphaz ni a pathung.

content.text: Tami a lungkaang ni ahrawnghrang panuenae hoi maw a pathung han.
Kanîtholae kahlî hoi a von a paha sak han namaw.
Bang patopatang kaawm hoeh e lawk hno lahoi thoseh,
hawinae ka sak thai hoeh e lawk ni a poukkhai han maw.
Cathut takinae hoi ama koe ratoum e hah na ngang pouh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, na payonpakainae ni,
na pahni hah a cangkhai teh, huenghai onae lawk hah na kârawi.
Kai ni nang yon na pen hoeh.
Na pahni roeroe ni doeh yon na pen.
Hmaloe poung khe e lah maw na o,
hoeh pawiteh monnaw ao hoehnahlan vah sak e lah na o toung maw.
Cathut e khokhangnae hah na panue toung maw,
Lungangnae he nang hane dueng lah maw ao.
Kaimouh ni ka panue hoeh e bangmaw na panue,
kaimouh dawk kaawm hoeh e bangmaw na panue thai.
Kaimouh thung dawkvah sampo ka po e hoi kacuepoung e,
na pa hlak hai kacuehnawn e ka o awh kaima.
Cathut ni a dei e lungmawngnae lawk kanem teh
nang hanlah a patawpoung maw
Bang kecu dawk maw, na lungthin ni na kahmakhai,
bang kecu dawk maw avangvanglah pou na hmaiet.
Na muitha ni Cathut taranlahoi pou a kamlang teh,
hot patet e lawknaw na pahni dawk hoi na tâco sak.
Tami teh banglamaw ao teh, a thoung thai han.
Napui ni a khe e teh, banglamaw ao teh, a lan thai han.
A tamikathoungnaw patenghai,
Cathut ni kâuepkhai hoeh.
A mithmu vah kalvan patenghai thounghoeh pawiteh,
Panuet ka tho e, kakhin e, payonpakainae hah,
tui patetlah ka net e teh, banghloimaw hoe kathounghoehe la ao han.
Thaihaw, ka dei vai,
ka hmu e hah ka pâpho han.
Tami a lungkaangnaw ni ouk a dei e
mintoe koehoi e hmu e hno a hro awh hoeh e hah.
Ahnimouh dueng a poe e ram,
ram alouknaw a othaihoenae hah.
Tamikathoutnaw ni a hring na thung patawnae a khang.
Amamouh kum yit touh rep kacuengroenaw koe a hro.
Takitho e pawlawk hah amamae hnâ ni a thai teh,
hnopai a tawn nah, ka raphoe hane naw ni a thosin awh.
Hmonae thung hoi kamlang hane hah yuem hoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahni teh tahloi ni a ring toe.
Ca hane tawng hanelah a kâva teh,
nâmaw hote teh ao telah a ti.
Hmonae hnin teh a kut dawk a pha toe tie hah a panue.
Rucatnae hoi kângairunae ni a lungpuen sak,
tarantuk hanelah coungkacoe kaawm e siangpahrang patetlah tâ e la ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut taranlahoi a kut a dâw teh,
Athakasaipounge taranlahoi kâoupnae hoi a kâroe.
Bahling katha poung e hoi, lung ka patak poung e lahoi
Cathut tuk hanelah a yawng sin.
Athaw ni a minhmai muen a ramuk teh,
a keng thouk kathâw nakunghai,
kingkadi e khopui dawk kho a sak teh,
apinihai a ohoehnae, kingdi e kho dawk ao.
Tawnta mahoeh, hoeh pawiteh, a tawnta e hnopainaw kangning mahoeh,
hoeh pawiteh a tawn e hah talai dawk pungdaw mahoeh.
Hmonae thung hoi tâcawt mahoeh.
Hmaipalai ni a kangnaw hah a kak han,
a pahni dawk e kahlî hoi be a kahma sak han.
Amahoima a kâdum teh, bang hoeh e hah kâuep han seh,
bangkongtetpawiteh, a tawkphu teh banghai bang nahoeh.
Atueng akuep hoehnahlan vah, kuep sak lah ao awh vaiteh,
akangnaw hah naw mahoeh toe.
Misurkangnaw patetlah ka hmin hoeh rae a paw a sarut totouh kahû en vai teh,
Olive thing patetlah a pei hah koung a sarut han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tamikathoutnaw hoi kamyawng e teh,
caici lah ao han. Tadawngnae hoi sak e im teh, hmai ni be a kak han.
Kahawi hoeh e hah a vawn teh, bang hoeh e hah a khe awh.
A von dawk laithoe a vawn awh telah a ti.
